name: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD 2024–25 published-rate district comparison
model_scope: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD independent 2024–25 published-rate grade-school district models use exact operational CCD LEA 4816110 / TX-101907 / TAPR district 101907 identities. All 78 native enrolled positive grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles remain searchable and enter each separate Math, ELA and Combined model using original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above rates and precise same-year individual economic-status enrollment ratios. Thirteen high schools, one primary campus and two operational alternative campuses without native records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Cypress-Fairbanks ISD source release.

income_definition.label: Individually classified economic disadvantage
income_definition.definition: Individual October 25, 2024 PEIMS fall economic status uses each school’s own count of individually classified economically disadvantaged pupils divided by its own all-enrolled EE–12 count. State codes 01/02/99 include free or reduced-price meal eligibility or other public assistance. ED plus non-ED and the native tenth-percent display must reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy is not uniform FRPL or household income and does not exactly describe the tested pupils. CEP requires individual direct certification and annual local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all children. Provision 2 may retain base-year eligibility for continuously enrolled students. Missing surveys may yield code 00; identification coverage and undercount are unknown. The January 16, 2025 resubmission extension requires enrollment and eligibility on October 25, 2024, without another-year backfill.
